title: Secret electrogravitic propulsion programs
plain: The US is said to have run secret projects on electrogravitic propulsion, a way of moving craft by using electricity to work against gravity. Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official turned whistleblower, names it in passing, "Electromagnetic. Electrogravitic," and ties it to Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor who worked on the idea. If true, it would mean such hidden propulsion has been under study for years.
